```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanSeeAllPolicy as BasePolicy;

class UserPolicy extends BasePolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow viewing all users
    }

    public function view(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return true; // Allow viewing specific user
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow creating a new user
    }

    public function update(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return true; // Allow updating a specific user
    }

    public function delete(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return true; // Allow deleting a specific user
    }
}
```
